name: Darla Mead

bio.statement: The Capital Chronicle voter guide lists Mead as an oncology nurse navigator.

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists Mead's occupation as oncology nurse navigator, with a background as bedside RN, infusion RN and clinical nursing instructor.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Oncology Nurse Navigator Occupational Background: Bedside RN, Infusion RN, Clinical Nursing Instructor

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists a nursing BS from Oregon Health & Science University and an associate degree in nursing from Clackamas Community College.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Oregon Health & Science University Nursing School, Bachelor of Science in Nursing; Clackamas Community College, Associates in Nursing

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists no prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Mead's pamphlet statement says she would use her knowledge of the healthcare system to deliver affordable, accessible healthcare to every Oregonian.
positions.excerpt: I’ll use my knowledge of our healthcare system to deliver affordable, accessible healthcare to every Oregonian.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Mead's pamphlet statement calls for removing barriers for small businesses, uplifting working families, and lowering the cost of housing and utilities.
positions.excerpt: We must remove barriers for small businesses, uplift working families, lower the cost of housing and utilities, and grow our communities while preserving our unique, small-town cultures.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Mead's pamphlet statement supports fully funded schools, career training and workforce readiness, and policies that recognize the challenges of rural districts.
positions.excerpt: I support fully funded schools, career training and workforce readiness, and policies that recognize the challenges faced by rural districts.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Mead's pamphlet statement commits to sustainability measures that preserve water, forests and wild spaces while expanding clean energy jobs.
positions.excerpt: I’m committed to real sustainability measures that preserve our water, forests, and wild spaces while expanding the clean energy jobs of the future.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Mead's pamphlet statement says she will protect individual rights and ensure every Oregonian is treated equally under the law.
positions.excerpt: I’ll protect individual rights and ensure that every Oregonian is treated equally under the law.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Mead says health insurance should not depend on employment status, job quality or employer.
positions.excerpt: Health insurance should not depend on your employment status, job quality, or employer.

source.publisher: Darla Mead campaign website (darlameadfororegon.com)

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Mead says she will fight to reduce the burden on small business, strengthen schools and grow local economies.
positions.excerpt: I'll fight to reduce the burden on small business, strengthen our schools, and grow our economies

source.publisher: Darla Mead campaign website (darlameadfororegon.com)
